args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). The advisory
lists 2.9.4 as the fixed version for the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Per the advisory, affected ranges are <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; 2.9.4 is the fixed version on the 2.x line, so we upgrade within the major version.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
